lines.zh: 我的爪子刮过玄武岩柱
lines.en: My claws rake the basalt columns.

lines.zh: 我在三角洲的热气里低飞
lines.en: I fly low through the delta's heat.

lines.zh: 翅膀擦过岩壁，扬起灰
lines.en: My wings brush stone and raise ash.

lines.zh: 我一步一步丈量这片荒地
lines.en: I pace out this waste, step by step.

lines.zh: 碎石在我脚下滚动
lines.en: Loose rock rolls beneath my feet.

lines.zh: 我从石柱跳到另一根石柱
lines.en: I leap from column to column.

lines.zh: 尾巴扫过地面，留下沟
lines.en: My tail sweeps a groove in the ground.

lines.zh: 我沿着熔岩边缘走
lines.en: I walk the rim of the lava field.

lines.zh: 灰落在我背上，又滑下去
lines.en: Ash settles on my back and slides off.

lines.zh: 我拖着翼膜，穿过岩石缝隙
lines.en: I drag my wing membrane through the rocks.

lines.zh: 低处太窄，我收起了翅
lines.en: Too narrow down here; I fold my wings.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，灰又落下
lines.en: Ash falls again where I have walked.

lines.zh: 我停在玄武岩柱顶，看下面
lines.en: I perch atop a basalt column and look down.

lines.zh: 我甩掉翼膜上的灰
lines.en: I flick the ash off my wing membrane.

lines.zh: 我的喉咙里有一点热
lines.en: A little heat rolls in my throat.

lines.zh: 风从石缝穿过，像哨声
lines.en: Wind through the cracks sounds like a whistle.

lines.zh: 我用角蹭石柱，沙沙响
lines.en: I rub my horn on the column; it rasps.

lines.zh: 我把头埋到翼下取暖
lines.en: I tuck my head under a wing for warmth.

lines.zh: 我数石柱，数到一半就困了
lines.en: I count columns and doze halfway.

lines.zh: 远处岩浆冒了个泡
lines.en: A lava bubble pops in the distance.

lines.zh: 我的爪子在地面抓出四道痕
lines.en: Four grooves where my claws settle.

lines.zh: 静静待着，比飞省力
lines.en: Stillness costs less than flight.

lines.zh: 我张开嘴，让热气散出去
lines.en: I open my jaw and let the heat out.

lines.zh: 灰落在我的角上，我不擦
lines.en: Ash lands on my horn; I leave it.

lines.zh: 我听着石头冷却的轻响
lines.en: I listen to stone cooling with faint clicks.

lines.zh: 这片荒地，暂时没有别人
lines.en: For now, no one else shares this waste.

lines.zh: 你站在灰里，很显眼
lines.en: You stand out plainly against the ash.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛比你的头还大
lines.en: My eye is bigger than your entire head.

lines.zh: 你抬头看我，脖子一定很酸
lines.en: Looking up at me must strain your neck.

lines.zh: 你铠甲上那股铁腥气
lines.en: That iron tang comes off your armor.

lines.zh: 你手里的盾太小了
lines.en: That shield in your hand is far too small.

lines.zh: 我偏头，是为了看清你
lines.en: I tilt my head to see you properly.

lines.zh: 你不该站在熔岩边上
lines.en: You should not stand beside the lava.

lines.zh: 我眨了眨眼，灰掉了下来
lines.en: I blink and ash falls from my lids.

lines.zh: 你数过我的角有几节吗
lines.en: Have you counted the ridges on my horn?

lines.zh: 你的影子在我脚边，太小
lines.en: Your shadow at my feet is tiny.

lines.zh: 你的气味已经进了我的鼻子
lines.en: Your scent is already deep in my nostrils.

lines.zh: 别挥剑，我看着累
lines.en: Do not wave that sword; it tires my eyes.

lines.zh: 鳞片替你挡了半剑
lines.en: My scales ate half of that swing.

lines.zh: 这一下打在翼根，很疼
lines.en: That landed at my wing root; it hurts.

lines.zh: 我嘶了一声，石头都在响
lines.en: I hiss and the stones ring.

lines.zh: 你砍到了旧伤
lines.en: You found an old wound.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀差点收不住
lines.en: My wings nearly failed to fold.

lines.zh: 血滴在热石上，滋滋作响
lines.en: Blood hisses on the hot rock.

lines.zh: 我退开，是为了重新起飞
lines.en: I back off to take flight again.

lines.zh: 别以为一次命中就够了
lines.en: One hit is not the whole fight.

lines.zh: 疼得我脑子反而清楚了
lines.en: The sting clears my head instead.

lines.zh: 我的角上，多了个缺口
lines.en: A chip is missing from my horn.

lines.zh: 肉？我更喜欢吃烤过的
lines.en: Meat? I prefer mine roasted.

lines.zh: 你举着那块肉，像在求饶
lines.en: Holding up meat like a plea for mercy.

lines.zh: 我一口能吞下你整只手
lines.en: One bite would take your whole hand.

lines.zh: 我要的是活的，不是那块
lines.en: I want it living, not that cut.

lines.zh: 飞龙的胃口，你养不起
lines.en: You cannot afford a wyvern's appetite.

lines.zh: 你退后两步，我就考虑一下
lines.en: Step back twice and I might consider.

lines.zh: 我低下脖子，不代表我温顺
lines.en: My neck lowers; that is not tameness.

lines.zh: 食物得扔远一点，别烫着我
lines.en: Toss it further; do not scald me.

lines.zh: 我不吃来路不明的东西
lines.en: I do not eat things of unknown origin.

lines.zh: 你把肉放下，人可以走
lines.en: Leave the meat; you may go.

lines.zh: 你撞上我的腿，像撞石柱
lines.en: You hit my leg like a basalt column.

lines.zh: 我侧身，你就滑开了
lines.en: I shift my flank and you slide off.

lines.zh: 别站在我翅膀底下
lines.en: Do not stand under my wings.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴碰到你，你就飞了
lines.en: My tail touches you and you fly.

lines.zh: 让路，我要转身
lines.en: Make room; I am turning.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的翼尖了
lines.en: You stepped on my wing tip.

lines.zh: 撞一下不算攻击，只是提醒
lines.en: A bump is no attack, only a reminder.

lines.zh: 我的鳞片比你的甲硬
lines.en: My scales are harder than your plate.

lines.zh: 石柱之间很窄，别挤
lines.en: The columns are narrow; do not crowd me.

lines.zh: 我落地时，地面会抖
lines.en: When I land, the ground shakes.

lines.zh: 飞龙求偶时，会绕圈飞
lines.en: Wyverns court by circling in the air.

lines.zh: 我鸣叫，是为了让远处听见
lines.en: I call so the distance can hear me.

lines.zh: 我的角越亮，越受欢迎
lines.en: The brighter my horn, the better my prospects.

lines.zh: 我们在石柱上空互相追逐
lines.en: We chase each other above the columns.

lines.zh: 她若回应，我就落下岩台
lines.en: If she answers, I descend to the ledge.

lines.zh: 旱季太长，我还没遇见她
lines.en: The dry season runs long; I have not met her.

lines.zh: 同类很少，撞见一只便珍贵
lines.en: Our kind is few; one meeting is precious.

lines.zh: 我的气味留在石柱顶部
lines.en: My scent marks the tops of the columns.

lines.zh: 求偶的舞，要先飞得够高
lines.en: The courtship dance begins high in the air.

lines.zh: 配对之后，巢筑在热岩上
lines.en: After pairing, the nest goes on hot stone.

lines.zh: 我用爪子拨了拨那块石头
lines.en: I nudge that stone with a claw.

lines.zh: 地上掉的，多半是烫的
lines.en: What falls here is usually hot.

lines.zh: 我叼起一块骨头，又放下
lines.en: I pick up a bone and set it down.

lines.zh: 我不捡亮东西，那不是我的活
lines.en: I do not collect shiny things; that is not my work.

lines.zh: 这块肉掉在灰里，可惜
lines.en: That meat landed in the ash; a pity.

lines.zh: 爪子太钝，夹不住小物件
lines.en: My claws are too blunt for small things.

lines.zh: 我把石头翻过来看了看
lines.en: I flip a stone over to look.

lines.zh: 你掉的角，不如我的硬
lines.en: The horn you dropped is softer than mine.

lines.zh: 留在原地，等它冷却
lines.en: Leave it there until it cools.

lines.zh: 我捡起来，只是闻一闻
lines.en: I only lift things to sniff them.

lines.zh: 你在灰里动，我看见了
lines.en: You moved in the ash; I saw it.

lines.zh: 这声脚步，不像石头滚落
lines.en: That tread is not a rolling stone.

lines.zh: 翅膀一张，热光就暗了
lines.en: My wings open and the hot glare dims.

lines.zh: 从石柱上方，我看得很清楚
lines.en: From the column top, I see everything.

lines.zh: 你想穿过荒地，得先问我
lines.en: To cross this waste, you must ask me.

lines.zh: 我锁定了那个移动的影子
lines.en: I have marked that moving shape.

lines.zh: 翅膀收拢，就是要落下的意思
lines.en: Folded wings mean I am coming down.

lines.zh: 你身上的铁，先吸引了我
lines.en: The iron on you drew me first.

lines.zh: 熔岩边上的动静，我从不忽略
lines.en: I never ignore movement by the lava.

lines.zh: 我已经转向你了
lines.en: I have turned to face you.

lines.zh: 别跑，跑只会让翅膀更快
lines.en: Do not run; running only hastens my wings.

lines.zh: 这片荒地上，我是最大的
lines.en: On this waste, I am the largest thing.

lines.zh: 我抬头，是因为闻到了血
lines.en: I raise my head; I smell blood.

lines.zh: 你走进了我的猎场
lines.en: You have entered my hunting ground.

lines.zh: 你在桥那边，我先盯桥。
lines.en: You are across the bridge. I watch the bridge first.

lines.zh: 这身甲反光，藏不住你。
lines.en: That armor glints. It gives you away.

lines.zh: 我在你头顶盘旋，等破绽
lines.en: I circle overhead, waiting for a gap.

lines.zh: 你抬盾的动作太慢了
lines.en: Your shield comes up too slowly.

lines.zh: 我压低翅膀，准备俯冲
lines.en: I lower my wings, ready to dive.

lines.zh: 你退到石柱边，反而更糟
lines.en: Retreating to the column makes it worse.

lines.zh: 灰遮住我的影子，你还看得见吗
lines.en: Ash hides my shadow; can you still see me?

lines.zh: 我绕第二圈时，你换手了
lines.en: On my second pass, you switched hands.

lines.zh: 我盯的是你的后颈
lines.en: My eyes are on the back of your neck.

lines.zh: 热气让我的轮廓在晃
lines.en: Heat makes my outline ripple.

lines.zh: 你抬头找我，脖子会酸的
lines.en: Keep looking up and your neck will ache.

lines.zh: 我贴着岩壁飞，声音很小
lines.en: I skim the rock face almost silently.

lines.zh: 你数着圈，我故意多绕一圈
lines.en: You count my circles; I add one more.

lines.zh: 我的角在低角度下最危险
lines.en: My horn is deadliest at a low angle.

lines.zh: 你背靠石柱，我正好落下
lines.en: Back to the column, you are under my line.

lines.zh: 等你的脚离开沙地那一刻
lines.en: I wait for your foot to leave the ground.

lines.zh: 我数你的盾，一共三次举。
lines.en: I count your shield raises: three so far.

lines.zh: 你贴着灰走，我顺着灰找。
lines.en: You move along the ash, and I follow the ash.

lines.zh: 翅膀张到一半，风就变了。
lines.en: My wings half-open, and the wind turns.

lines.zh: 我的角从侧面撞上你的肩
lines.en: My horn takes your shoulder from the side.

lines.zh: 爪子按住你的盾，压下去
lines.en: My claws pin your shield and press.

lines.zh: 我一尾巴抽在你腿上
lines.en: A swing of my tail takes your legs.

lines.zh: 这一口咬碎了你的护肩
lines.en: This bite crunches through your pauldron.

lines.zh: 你被撞得滑出去两格
lines.en: You slide two blocks from the hit.

lines.zh: 我的翅膜扫过，风声很响
lines.en: My wing membrane sweeps past with a roar.

lines.zh: 落地时，你的脚陷进灰里
lines.en: On landing, your feet sink into the ash.

lines.zh: 我咬住你的剑，甩了出去
lines.en: I bite your blade and fling it off.

lines.zh: 第二次俯冲更准
lines.en: My second dive lands truer.

lines.zh: 你的血在热石上冒烟
lines.en: Your blood steams on the hot stone.

lines.zh: 我把你按在岩柱上
lines.en: I press you against the column.

lines.zh: 角尖划开了你的护腿
lines.en: My horn tip splits your leggings.

lines.zh: 你挡得住上，挡不住下
lines.en: You block high; you cannot block low.

lines.zh: 飞龙的攻击，从三个方向来
lines.en: A wyvern strikes from three directions.

lines.zh: 我从玄武岩的裂缝里站起来
lines.en: I rise out of a basalt fissure.

lines.zh: 热浪先到，然后是我
lines.en: The heat wave comes first, then me.

lines.zh: 我的第一声叫，震落了灰
lines.en: My first cry shakes ash off the stone.

lines.zh: 岩柱上多了一个影子
lines.en: One more shadow on the columns.

lines.zh: 我展开翅膀，灰被吹开了
lines.en: I spread my wings and the ash parts.

lines.zh: 这窝蛋，孵出了我这一只
lines.en: Of that clutch, only I hatched.

lines.zh: 我踩在还温热的石头上
lines.en: I step onto stone still warm.

lines.zh: 熔岩的响动，像我心跳
lines.en: The lava's pulse matches mine.

lines.zh: 我在恶地的边缘睁开眼
lines.en: I open my eyes at the badlands' edge.

lines.zh: 沙漠的太阳一照，我就知道方向
lines.en: One desert sun and I know my way.

lines.zh: 翅膀第一次张开，有点疼
lines.en: First spread of my wings; it stings.

lines.zh: 我选了最高的石柱站上去
lines.en: I chose the tallest column to stand on.

lines.zh: 风告诉我，这里归我了
lines.en: The wind tells me this place is mine.

lines.zh: 灰落定了，我出来了
lines.en: The ash settles, and I emerge.

lines.zh: 我从灰堆下面顶开一条路。
lines.en: I push a path up through the ash heap.

lines.zh: 这具翅膀，第一次扇就带火星。
lines.en: On the first beat of these wings, sparks fly.

lines.zh: 火我不怕，可这温度不对劲
lines.en: Fire I can bear, but this heat is wrong.

lines.zh: 落地失准，我的腿折了一下
lines.en: A bad landing buckled one of my legs.

lines.zh: 水灌进翼膜，我飞不起来了
lines.en: Water fills my wing membrane; I cannot fly.

lines.zh: 冲击把我的鳞掀开了
lines.en: The blast peeled my scales back.

lines.zh: 一支箭扎在翅骨缝里
lines.en: An arrow is lodged between wing bones.

lines.zh: 有什么东西缠住我的角
lines.en: Something has wound itself around my horn.

lines.zh: 饿得我连石头都想咬
lines.en: Hunger makes me bite at stone.

lines.zh: 雷顺着我的角走到骨头里
lines.en: Lightning runs my horn down into bone.

lines.zh: 底下什么都没有，翅膀抓不住
lines.en: Nothing below; my wings find no air.
